standard_prerequisites.name: Push-pull compatibility of the bivariant action (relative-cycles chapter, Lemma lemma-action-push-pull, canonical tag 0H6B)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the fibrewise identity f_*(g^* alpha cap -) = alpha cap g_*(-) underlying the family statement.

core_obligations: Show f_*(g^*(alpha) circ beta') = alpha circ g_* beta' for the cartesian square with g proper (proof lines 2916-2919). Unwinding the family-level definitions: the composition of families and the pushforward of families are both defined fibre-wise over the base, so both sides are the families of the fibrewise identities; at each point of the base the fibrewise identity is exactly lemma-action-push-pull (tag 0H6B), whence the family equality (proof lines 2917-2918; soft-point note: the unwinding is the mechanical fibre-wise reading of the constructions).
proof_roadmap: Unwind the family-level identity to fibre-wise identities via the definitions of the composition and of pushforward of families (proof lines 2916-2917).
Apply the action push-pull lemma on each fibre (proof lines 2917-2918).
